extDescription.message: Enter / double-click opens a message in its conversation (the whole thread, across folders) instead of the single message.

cmdOpenConversation.message: Open the selected message in its conversation

optMiddleClick.message: Middle-click (otherwise opens the message in a new tab)

optSkipSingleHint.message: When the conversation has only one message (no replies anywhere, Sent included), open it as a plain message instead of a conversation tab.

optShortcutHint.message: Shortcut $KEY$ always opens the conversation. Change it in the Add-ons Manager under "Manage Extension Shortcuts".
